messages.summary:
## Objective
- Clean and improve the existing HELIX evolution game into a complete, playable simulation.
- Add complex tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build the game now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or feature changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing Vite/Three.js game and its source files.
- Installed dependencies with `npm install --no-audit --no-fund`.
- Started the development server on port 3002.

### Active
- Determine how the current ecology and evolution systems should be extended, then implement the requested gameplay features.

### Blocked
- Browser-based visual testing is blocked because Chromium is not installed; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed with: `Browser "chromium" is not installed`. No screenshot has been captured.

## Next Move
1. Inspect existing simulation, UI, and controls in `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/creature.js`.
2. Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, and nutrient distribution/impact as playable systems with visible UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build`, resolve any errors, and test the running game; install/use a browser if available to capture the requested latest JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize the assumptions and changes.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing game interface and help/guide content.
- `src/main.js`: Game initialization, UI state, and simulation controls.
- `src/genetics.js`: Current genome traits, mutation, selection, and evaluation.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment and world rendering.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, appearance, and selection.
- `src/style.css`: Game interface and responsive styling.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- Repository was clean at initial inspection; no source files have been modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `npm install` completed; install output warned that `esbuild@0.25.12` has an install script not yet covered by allowScripts.

## Objective
- Clean and improve the existing HELIX evolution game into a complete, playable simulation.
- Add complex tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or feature changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing Vite/Three.js game and its source files.
- Installed dependencies with `npm install --no-audit --no-fund`.
- Started the development server on port 3002.

### Active
- Inspect and extend the simulation, UI, and controls for tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, and nutrients.
- Build and test the game, then capture a screenshot if browser testing is available.

### Blocked
- Browser-based visual testing is blocked because Chromium is not installed; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed with: `Browser "chromium" is not installed`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, and `src/creature.js`.
2. Implement the requested gameplay systems with visible UI feedback.

4. Summarize assumptions and changes.

## Relevant Files

- `src/main.js`: Game initialization, UI state, and simulation controls.

- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment and rendering.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, appearance, and selection.
- `src/style.css`: Interface and responsive styling.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Objective
- Clean and improve the existing HELIX evolution game into a complete, playable simulation.
- Add complex tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No implementation or feature decisions have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the Vite/Three.js game and its source files; installed dependencies and started the development server.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients with visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game, then capture a small JPEG if browser testing becomes available.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing is blocked because Chromium is not installed; `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed with `Browser "chromium" is not installed`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html` to implement the requested gameplay systems and UI feedback.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test the running game if browser testing becomes available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been modified.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- The development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `npm install --no-audit --no-fund` completed with an `esbuild@0.25.12` install-script warning related to allowScripts.
- Flora and fruit are already present in `src/world.js`; forage settings currently show/hide and scale fruit. Existing organisms use a cellular/organism stage distinction.

## Objective
- Complete the existing HELIX evolution game as a playable simulation, adding tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the Vite/Three.js game source and started the development server.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, environmental nutrients, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html` to implement the requested gameplay systems and UI feedback.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been modified; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- The development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- Flora and fruit are already present in `src/world.js`; forage settings currently show/hide and scale fruit. Existing organisms use a cellular/organism stage distinction.
- `npm install --no-audit --no-fund` completed with an `esbuild@0.25.12` install-script warning related to allowScripts.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the Vite/Three.js game and inspected simulation, genetics, world, creature, and interface code.
- Confirmed existing flora/fruit and cellular-to-organism stages provide a starting point for the additions.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been modified; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- Flora and fruit are already present in `src/world.js`; forage settings currently show/hide and scale fruit. Existing organisms already have cellular and organism stages.
- `npm install --no-audit --no-fund` completed with an `esbuild@0.25.12` install-script warning related to allowScripts.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the Vite/Three.js game, including simulation, genetics, world, creature, and interface code.
- Confirmed existing flora/fruit and cellular-to-organism stages provide a starting point for the additions.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement the requested gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been modified; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- Flora and fruit are already present in `src/world.js`; forage settings currently show/hide and scale fruit.
- `Creature` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; tissue/bone development can build on these materials.
- Existing organisms already have cellular and organism stages.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing Vite/Three.js game and identified flora/fruit and cellular-to-organism stages as starting points.
- No source changes have been made.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; other source files are unmodified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- Flora and fruit are already present in `src/world.js`; forage settings currently show/hide and scale fruit.
- `Creature` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; tissue/bone development can build on these materials.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing Vite/Three.js game and reviewed simulation, genetics, creature, world, and interface code.
- Identified existing flora/fruit and cellular-to-organism stages as starting points.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source changes have been made.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- Flora and fruit are already present in `src/world.js`; forage settings currently show/hide and scale fruit.
- `Creature` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; tissue/bone development can build on these materials.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the existing Vite/Three.js game and reviewed simulation, genetics, creature, world, and interface code.
- Confirmed existing flora/fruit, cellular-to-organism stages, and bone materials as potential foundations.
- Located relevant implementation points for stage rendering, generation advancement, and food environment updates.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source changes have been made.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes and currently toggles their visibility and scale based on forage settings.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; anatomy is currently creature-focused.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected current simulation, genetics, rendering, environment, and UI code to identify implementation points.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source changes have been made.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes and toggles their visibility and scale based on forage settings.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; anatomy is currently creature-focused.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.
- Build and test the game, adding visible gameplay feedback.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected simulation, genetics, rendering, environment, and UI code to identify implementation points.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source changes have been made yet.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes and toggles their visibility and scale based on forage settings.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; anatomy is currently creature-focused.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.
- Build and test the game with visible gameplay feedback.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected genetics, simulation/UI code, creature anatomy, and world flora/environment hooks.

### Active
- Implement tissue/bone and neural evolution, plant organisms, nutrient interactions, and visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Implement gameplay systems and UI feedback across `src/main.js`, `src/genetics.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/creature.js`, and `index.html`; style as needed in `src/style.css`.
2. Run `npm run build` and resolve any errors; test in a browser if one is available.
3. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environment controls, and UI updates.
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source changes have been made yet.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes and toggles their visibility and scale based on forage settings.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.

- **Genetics and selection** — [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/genetics.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/genetics.js) defines ten scalar traits in `GENE_KEYS`, mutates them, evaluates fitness, and breeds populations. `evaluate` currently scores thermal adaptation, foraging, defense, and efficiency.
- **Organism construction and behavior** — [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/creature.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/creature.js) builds anatomy from genes in `Creature.build()` and handles movement and animation in `Creature.update(dt)`. Existing anatomy includes body proportions and armor details, but no explicit tissue, bone, or neural-system model was identified.
- **Environment and rendering** — [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js) holds `World.environment` (`climate`, `food`, `predators`) and applies those values to lighting, fruit visibility/scale, and predator visuals. Flora and food visuals exist; a nutrient-composition model or plant-organism population was not identified.
- **Orchestration and feedback** — [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js) connects UI state, genetics, environment, and gameplay. It already provides fitness/component feedback, trait bars, toasts, field logs, and generation advancement.
- **Interface** — [`/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`](/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html) contains the relevant controls and feedback elements.

## Minimal implementation touchpoints

1. **Tissue and bone evolution:** Extend `GENE_KEYS` and the mutation/evaluation paths in `genetics.js` with a small number of structural traits. Use those traits in `Creature.build()` to affect anatomy, and optionally in `evaluate` to score tradeoffs such as strength, durability, and resource cost.
2. **Neural evolution:** There is no identified neural-network architecture to extend. The smallest initial step is to add a compact set of behavioral traits or parameters to the genome and have `Creature.update(dt)` use them to change behavior. A more complex evolving network would require new genome representation and evaluation logic in `genetics.js`, plus execution in `creature.js`.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, brain/neuron development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.
- Build and test the game with visible gameplay feedback.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, simulation, creature, world, interface, and styling code to identify extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue/bone and neural traits and connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Add plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions with visible gameplay feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `src/genetics.js` with tissue/bone and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects; connect them to `src/creature.js`.
2. Add plant lifecycle and environmental nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and resolve errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source changes have been made yet.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with tissue and bone evolution, neural development, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.
- Build and test the game with visible gameplay feedback.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, simulation, creature, world, interface, and styling code to identify extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue/bone and neural traits and connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Add plant lifecycle and environmental nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `src/genetics.js` with tissue/bone and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects; connect them to `src/creature.js`.
2. Add plant lifecycle and environmental nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and resolve errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, and selection.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed yet; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.
- `src/genetics.js` uses `GENE_KEYS`, `GENE_META`, and `TRAIT_ROWS` for genome traits and displayed rows; `src/main.js` builds trait rows dynamically.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.
- Build and test the game with visible gameplay feedback.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature, world, interface, and styling code to identify extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue/bone and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects in `src/genetics.js`; connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature, world, interface, and styling code to identify extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue/bone and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects in `src/genetics.js`; connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.
- Recent inspection confirmed genes are defined in `GENE_KEYS`, and crossover, mutation, and diversity iterate over that list; founder genomes in `src/main.js` currently provide 10 traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives the displayed trait rows and mutation selection; fitness and target bars are computed in `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()`.
- Fruit bushes are constructed in `World.buildFruit()` and toggled/scaled in `World.applyEnvironment()`. `World.tick()` updates existing environmental effects.
- Creature anatomy is constructed in `Creature.build()` and its behavior in `Creature.update()`; the current movement routine has no plant or nutrient interactions.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature, world, interface, and styling code to identify extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue/bone and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects in `src/genetics.js`; connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.
- Genes are defined in `GENE_KEYS`; crossover, mutation, and diversity iterate over that list; founder genomes in `src/main.js` currently provide 10 traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; fitness and target bars are computed in `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()`.
- Fruit bushes are constructed in `World.buildFruit()` and toggled/scaled in `World.applyEnvironment()`; `World.tick()` updates existing environmental effects.
- Creature anatomy is constructed in `Creature.build()` and behavior in `Creature.update()`; current movement has no plant or nutrient interactions.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature, world, interface, and styling code to identify extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue/bone and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects in `src/genetics.js`; connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, and animation.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `src/creature.js` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.
- Genes are defined in `GENE_KEYS`; crossover, mutation, and diversity iterate over that list; founder genomes in `src/main.js` currently provide 10 traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; fitness and target bars are computed in `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()`.
- Fruit bushes are constructed in `World.buildFruit()` and toggled/scaled in `World.applyEnvironment()`; `World.tick()` updates existing environmental effects.
- Creature anatomy is constructed in `Creature.build()` and behavior in `Creature.update()`; current movement has no plant or nutrient interactions.
- `CreatureSystem.update(dt)` updates all creatures; `gameLoop()` in `src/main.js` calls it.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature anatomy/behavior, world flora/environment, and UI extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutation, and fitness effects in `src/genetics.js`; connect them to creature anatomy and behavior.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js` and `src/main.js`, with UI feedback.
- Build and test the game.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `src/world.js` has fruit bushes in `World.buildFruit()` whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `Creature` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; founder genomes in `src/main.js` currently provide 10 traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature anatomy/behavior, world flora/environment, and UI extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; founder genomes currently provide 10 traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `Creature` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- None yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature anatomy/behavior, world flora/environment, and UI extension points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Genome traits, fitness evaluation, mutation, selection, and displayed trait rows.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Simulation state, evolution, environmental controls, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; founder genomes currently provide 10 traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model was identified.
- `Creature` already defines `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat`; current anatomy is creature-focused.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature anatomy/behavior, world flora/environment, and UI integration points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: `GENE_KEYS`, `GENE_META`, `TRAIT_ROWS`, crossover/mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, body anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, fruit, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `FOUNDERS` in `src/main.js` define the current traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()` and its helpers; `boneMat` and `darkBoneMat` already exist.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates fruit bushes whose visibility and scale respond to forage settings; there is no plant-organism lifecycle or nutrient-composition model yet.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature anatomy/behavior, world flora/environment, and UI integration points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: `GENE_KEYS`, `GENE_META`, `TRAIT_ROWS`, crossover/mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, body anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, fruit, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `FOUNDERS` in `src/main.js` define current traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials exist, and movement currently uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` only changes their visibility and scale based on forage. There is no plant lifecycle or nutrient-composition model yet.
- UI integration points include `buildTraitRows()` and `updateSelectionUI()` in `src/main.js`, plus forage controls and ecological outlook in `index.html`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, creature anatomy/behavior, world flora/environment, and UI integration points.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle, nutrient interactions, and corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: `GENE_KEYS`, `GENE_META`, `TRAIT_ROWS`, crossover/mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, body anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, terrain, flora, fruit, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4; genomes currently have 10 genes.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `FOUNDERS` in `src/main.js` define current traits.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials exist, and movement currently uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` only changes their visibility and scale based on forage. There is no plant lifecycle or nutrient-composition model yet.
- UI integration points include `buildTraitRows()` and `updateSelectionUI()` in `src/main.js`, plus forage controls and ecological outlook in `index.html`.
- Additional inspection confirmed `GENE_KEYS` has 10 entries, `TRAIT_ROWS` currently displays seven traits, and `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations.
- The latest exchange only inspected source files; it did not modify source code.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected genetics, creature, world, and UI code to map where traits, fitness, plants, and environmental effects connect.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: `GENE_KEYS`, trait metadata/rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, and behavior.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit, and environmental effects.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `GENE_KEYS` currently has 10 genes and drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `FOUNDERS` in `src/main.js` define their initial values.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` currently only changes visibility and scale based on forage.
- `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations; environmental readouts are handled by `updateEnvironmentUI()`.
- `Creature.update()` handles organism movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, organism anatomy and behavior, environment, fitness, and UI integration points.
- Confirmed the 10 genes drive crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; inspected relevant code.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source files have been changed.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `World.buildFruit()` currently creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` only changes fruit visibility and scale based on forage.
- `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations; environmental readouts are handled by `updateEnvironmentUI()`.
- `Creature.update()` handles organism movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, organism anatomy and behavior, environment, fitness, and UI integration points.
- Confirmed the 10 existing genes drive crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.

4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `package-lock.json` is modified; no source files have been changed.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.

- `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations; environmental readouts are handled by `updateEnvironmentUI()`.
- `Creature.update()` handles organism movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.

- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, organism anatomy and behavior, environment, fitness, and UI integration points.
- Confirmed the existing 10 genes drive crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.

- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.

- `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations; environmental readouts are handled by `updateEnvironmentUI()`.
- `Creature.update()` handles organism movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, organism anatomy and behavior, environment, fitness, and UI integration points.
- Confirmed the existing 10 genes drive crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `package-lock.json` is modified.
- Development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `World.buildFruit()` currently creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` only changes fruit visibility and scale based on forage.
- `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations; environmental readouts are handled by `updateEnvironmentUI()`.
- `Creature.update()` handles organism movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.
