## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped genetics, organism anatomy and behavior, environment, fitness, and UI integration points.
- Confirmed the existing 10 genes drive crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation.
- Inspected relevant genetics, creature, world, and UI code; no source files have been changed.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `Creature.update()` handles movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.

- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.
- `package-lock.json` is modified; the development server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No new implementation decisions yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped the genetics, organism anatomy and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.
- Confirmed crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation iterate over `GENE_KEYS`.
- Inspected relevant genetics, creature, world, and UI code; no source files have been changed.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, with UI feedback.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend genetics and connect new traits to creature anatomy and behavior.
2. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions, and add corresponding UI feedback.
3. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
4. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Already modified before this work; preserve the existing change.

## Important Context
- `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection; `evaluate()` and `traitTargets()` compute fitness and target bars.
- Creature anatomy is built in `Creature.build()`; bone materials already exist, while movement uses speed, legs, and random roam targets.
- `Creature.update()` handles movement and animation; `CreatureSystem` manages population spawning and replacement.
- `World.buildFruit()` currently creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` changes their visibility and scale based on forage.
- `setEnvironment()` calls `world.applyEnvironment()` and recalculates organism evaluations; environmental readouts are handled by `updateEnvironmentUI()`.
- Population size is six; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.

- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits; plant organisms; and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation include new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, static fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` shows `M package-lock.json`.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing genome alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- `Creature.build()` constructs anatomy; movement currently uses speed, legs, and random roam targets. Bone materials/structures exist, but heritable tissue and neural traits are not modeled.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` toggles visibility and scales them based on forage. `setEnvironment()` updates the world and organism evaluations.
- The simulation has six organisms; the cellular stage transitions to organism stage at generation 4.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits; plant organisms; and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation include new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, static fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` shows `M package-lock.json`.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing genome alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- `Creature.build()` constructs anatomy; movement currently uses speed, legs, and random roam targets. Bone materials/structures exist, but heritable tissue and neural traits are not modeled.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` toggles visibility and scales them based on forage. `setEnvironment()` updates the world and organism evaluations.
- The six-organism simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4.
- The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)` in `src/main.js`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.
- Current genetics contain 10 genes; the field guide describes HELIX as a 10-gene genome. Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define those alleles.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No new implementation decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, founder genomes, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation support new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` showed `M package-lock.json`.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- `Creature.build()` constructs anatomy; movement currently uses speed, legs, and random roam targets. Bone materials/structures exist, but heritable tissue and neural traits are not modeled.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` toggles visibility and scales them based on forage. `setEnvironment()` updates the world and organism evaluations.
- The six-organism simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4. The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.
- Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define 10 alleles, and the field guide calls this a 10-gene genome; update the count and founder values when adding genes.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No new implementation decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, founder genomes, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation support new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` showed `M package-lock.json`.

- Existing alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define 10 alleles, and the field guide calls this a 10-gene genome; update the count and founder values when adding genes.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` toggles visibility and scales them based on forage.
- The six-organism simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4. The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, founder genomes, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation support new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` showed `M package-lock.json`.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define 10 alleles, and the field guide calls this a 10-gene genome; update the count and founder values when adding genes.
- Founder population has six organisms; simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4. The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` toggles visibility and scales them based on forage.

- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.

- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, founder genomes, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation support new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `package-lock.json`: Existing modification; preserve it.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` showed `M package-lock.json`.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define 10 alleles, and the field guide calls this a 10-gene genome; update the count and founder values when adding genes.
- Founder population has six organisms; simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4. The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.
- Fruit bushes are static (`World.buildFruit()`); `World.applyEnvironment()` currently only toggles their visibility and scale based on forage.
- `src/main.js` renders trait rows from `TRAIT_ROWS`; DNA-bank validation requires every `GENE_KEYS` allele to be finite and in `[0,1]`.
- The newest exploration confirmed creature construction is split across `buildNeck`, `buildTail`, `buildLegs`, `buildArmor`, and `buildAccents`; adult movement speed is set in `update(dt)`.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked

1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation support new alleles.

3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.

## Objective
- Complete HELIX as a playable evolution simulation with heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, plant organisms, and environmental nutrients that affect living organisms.

## Requirements
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot unless fine detail requires a full-size PNG.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored genetics, founder genomes, organism construction and behavior, environment, fitness, UI integration, and DNA-bank validation.

### Active
- Add heritable tissue, bone, and neural traits, mutations, fitness effects, and anatomy/behavior links.
- Implement a plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions in `src/world.js`, with UI feedback in `src/main.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser visual testing: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed.

## Next Move
1. Extend `GENE_KEYS`, metadata, trait rows, evaluation, and targets in `src/genetics.js`; ensure crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation support new alleles.
2. Connect tissue, bone, and neural traits to anatomy and behavior in `src/creature.js`.
3. Implement plant lifecycle and nutrient interactions; expose ecological feedback through `src/main.js` and `index.html`.
4. Run `npm run build` and address errors; test in a browser if available.
5. Capture a small JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px if possible, then summarize changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/genetics.js`: Gene keys, trait metadata and rows, mutation, fitness evaluation, and trait targets.
- `src/creature.js`: Creature construction, anatomy, movement, behavior, and `CreatureSystem`.
- `src/world.js`: Three.js environment, flora, fruit bushes, and `applyEnvironment()`.
- `src/main.js`: Founder genomes, simulation state, selection/evolution, DNA-bank validation, and UI updates.
- `index.html`: Game interface, environmental controls, dossier, and field guide.
- `src/style.css`: Interface styling and responsive layout.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` showed `M package-lock.json`. Preserve that existing modification.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define 10 alleles, and the field guide calls it a 10-gene genome; update the count and founder values when adding genes.
- Founder population has six organisms; simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4. The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` currently only toggles their visibility and scale based on forage.
- `src/main.js` renders trait rows from `TRAIT_ROWS`; DNA-bank validation requires every `GENE_KEYS` allele to be finite and in `[0,1]`.
- Creature construction is split across `buildNeck`, `buildTail`, `buildLegs`, `buildArmor`, and `buildAccents`; adult movement speed is set in `update(dt)`.

- No source files have been changed; `git status --short` showed `M package-lock.json`. Preserve that existing modification.
- `GENE_KEYS` drives crossover, mutation, diversity, and DNA-bank validation; `TRAIT_ROWS` drives displayed trait rows and mutation selection.
- Existing alleles are normalized to 0–1. New alleles must be initialized and supported by founder genomes and archived DNA as well as breeding and mutation.
- Founder genomes in `src/main.js` explicitly define 10 alleles, and the field guide calls it a 10-gene genome; update the count and founder values when adding genes.
- Founder population has six organisms; simulation starts in the cellular stage and transitions to organism stage at generation 4. The animation loop updates creatures via `creatures.update(dt)`; `World.tick()` animates environment visuals.
- `World.buildFruit()` creates static fruit bushes; `World.applyEnvironment()` currently only toggles their visibility and scale based on forage.
- `src/main.js` renders trait rows from `TRAIT_ROWS`; DNA-bank validation requires every `GENE_KEYS` allele to be finite and in `[0,1]`.
- Creature construction is split across `buildNeck`, `buildTail`, `buildLegs`, `buildArmor`, and `buildAccents`; adult movement speed is set in `update(dt)`.
